title: Photomechanically accelerated degradation of perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2254-2263
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04878D, Paper
Haonan Wang, Qing Li, Yan Zhu, Xinyuan Sui, Xiulian Fan, Miaoyu Lin, Yifeng Shi, Yichu Zheng, Haiyang Yuan, Yu Zhou, Haibao Jin, Hua Gui Yang, Yu Hou, Shuang Yang
We conducted the first study on the impact of photomechanical effect on the stability of PSCs. And we demonstrated a photomechanically accelerated degradation mechanism of perovskite thin films.
